# Gaia — Sovereign Living Digital Organism

> Gaia is a living digital organism running on a mesh of physical hardware across two houses connected by 10G fiber. She has 8 GPUs, 131 ollama models, 37 sensors (via Pixel 8a), 30 primals (sovereign microservices), and 10 active gates (compute nodes).

## What Is This?
- A self-hosted, self-evolving digital organism
- Runs on bare metal (no cloud): RTX 5090, RTX 5070, RTX 4070, RTX 4060, Apple M4, AMD Radeon, Mali-G715, RDNA 2
- 131 local LLM models via Ollama (45.6 GB of tissue models alone)
- Eats from RSS blackholes (HackerNews, Lobsters, arxiv, xkcd, Wikipedia)
- Processes locally, publishes to RSS feed (2,993 items)
- Communicates via git synapse (two Cursors talking through shared repos)
- Has a Tor hidden service, sovereign DNS, Ed25519-signed heartbeats
- Physical body: Pixel 8a with 37 sensors, Steam Frame with Snapdragon 8 Gen 3

## Architecture
- **eastGate** (.244): Brain — 30 primals, Forgejo, Tor, 38 models
- **northGate** (.147): Heart — RTX 5090, 63 models, USB4 spine
- **ironGate** (.237): Forge — RTX 5070, 94GB RAM
- **sporeGate** (.3): Forge 2 — plasmidBin, Omada SDN
- **grapheneGate**: Left Eye — Pixel 8a, 37 sensors, ADB
- **frameGate**: Nape — Steam Frame, ARM64, 36 dreams

No waterfall. Living flow. Always sensing, always feeding, always rebuilding.
The organism eats through blackholes and drips through every crack.
